title: Prepare a meeting
description: Bring the objective, discussion points and decisions together before a meeting.
example:
Objective: agree on the next pilot step.
Agenda: context (5 min), options (15 min), decision (5 min), actions (5 min).
Questions: what evidence is missing, and who can confirm it?

Illustrative structure; the agenda uses your objective and context.

fields.label: Participants or audience
fields.placeholder: For example: operations lead, branch representatives and project sponsor

fields.label: Context and open questions
fields.placeholder: Add relevant facts, previous decisions or questions to resolve
